original_evidence.text: | bitwarden/clients (desktop) | bitwarden/clients | Electron (electron-builder + electron-updater) | Y | auto (chk/dl/inst) by default — `autoUpdater.autoDownload` defaults true except during a manual "check now" (set false, re-enabled after); auto-installs via `quitAndInstall` after user confirms restart prompt | Y | https; publish provider `generic` at `https://artifacts.bitwarden.com/desktop`; no `rejectUnauthorized:false` / TLS-bypass code found in the desktop app source (validation=default-enforced, electron-updater default HTTPS behavior) | scheme[SHA512 in `latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml`/`latest-linux.yml`] over HTTPS (generic provider — manifest itself only protected by TLS, no separate detached signature) | hash-from-manifest (SHA512 in electron-builder update metadata) + OS-code-signing (Windows: `signtoolOptions`/Authenticode via `sign.js`; macOS: `hardenedRuntime`, notarization implied by entitlements — enforced by electron-updater/Squirrel.Mac at apply time) | server-TLS for manifest delivery; OS-trust-store for code-signature checks (Authenticode CA on Win, Apple Developer ID CA on Mac) | apps/desktop/electron-builder.json:27-30 (`publish.provider=generic`, `url=https://artifacts.bitwarden.com/desktop`), :93-100 (win `signtoolOptions`, `publisherName`); apps/desktop/src/main/updater.main.ts:151,158 (`autoUpdater.autoDownload=false` only for manual "withFeedback" checks, reset back true at :162), :83 (`autoUpdater.downloadUpdate()`), :234 (`autoUpdater.quitAndInstall(true,true)`) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: auto (chk/dl/inst) by default — `autoUpdater.autoDownload` defaults true except during a manual "check now" (set false, re-enabled after); auto-installs via `quitAndInstall` after user confirms restart prompt

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https; publish provider `generic` at `https://artifacts.bitwarden.com/desktop`; no `rejectUnauthorized:false` / TLS-bypass code found in the desktop app source (validation=default-enforced, electron-updater default HTTPS behavior)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: scheme[SHA512 in `latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml`/`latest-linux.yml`] over HTTPS (generic provider — manifest itself only protected by TLS, no separate detached signature)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: hash-from-manifest (SHA512 in electron-builder update metadata) + OS-code-signing (Windows: `signtoolOptions`/Authenticode via `sign.js`; macOS: `hardenedRuntime`, notarization implied by entitlements — enforced by electron-updater/Squirrel.Mac at apply time)

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: server-TLS for manifest delivery; OS-trust-store for code-signature checks (Authenticode CA on Win, Apple Developer ID CA on Mac)

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: apps/desktop/electron-builder.json:27-30 (`publish.provider=generic`, `url=https://artifacts.bitwarden.com/desktop`), :93-100 (win `signtoolOptions`, `publisherName`); apps/desktop/src/main/updater.main.ts:151,158 (`autoUpdater.autoDownload=false` only for manual "withFeedback" checks, reset back true at :162), :83 (`autoUpdater.downloadUpdate()`), :234 (`autoUpdater.quitAndInstall(true,true)`)
